tagline: Technology-enabled, asset-light provider of integrated transportation management solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary metric for tracking the consolidated business performance of the group, reflecting the company's ability to generate revenue through its network of independent sales agents and third-party providers

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the company across all operating segments
kpis.description: Consolidated total revenue of the company for fiscal year 2025. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 10 years.

kpis.name: Transportation Logistics Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from transportation logistics segment, representing approximately 99% of consolidated revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the transportation logistics segment, the primary component of consolidated revenues
kpis.signal: Core business segment generating the majority of revenue

kpis.name: Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from insurance segment representing reinsurance premiums, approximately 1% of consolidated revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the insurance segment (reinsurance premiums) for fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Minor insurance segment representing approximately 1% of consolidated revenue

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 4.74 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.signal: Total assets of 1.64 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt

kpis.name: Million Dollar Agents
kpis.explanation: Number of independent commission sales agents generating $1 million or more of Landstar revenue annually
kpis.description: Number of independent sales agents generating at least $1 million in annual revenue, declining from 485 (2024) to 457 (2025) due to weak freight demand
kpis.signal: Contraction in the number of key agents amid weak freight demand

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per MDA
kpis.explanation: Average annual revenue generated per Million Dollar Agent
kpis.description: Average revenue generated per sales agent for fiscal year 2025, increasing from 9.388 million (2024) to 9.827 million (2025)
kpis.signal: Slight increase in agent productivity despite contraction in agent count

kpis.name: MDA Revenue Concentration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated revenue generated by Million Dollar Agents
kpis.description: Agents generating over $1 million in annual revenue represent 95% of consolidated revenue in 2025, stable compared to 94% in 2024
kpis.signal: Significant reliance on key agent group generating 95% of revenue

risks.title: Increased Severity or Frequency of Accidents and Claims
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to potential liabilities associated with accidents in the trucking industry, with self-insurance coverage up to $5 million per incident. The unpredictability and severity of accidents constitute a major risk to operating results.

risks.title: Litigation and Claims Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation and claims related to traffic accidents and cargo damage. Associated costs could be significant and unpredictable.

risks.title: Dependence on Independent Commission Sales Agents
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its 960 independent sales agents to generate revenue, with 95% of revenue coming from 457 key agents. The loss of these agents, including the largest agent (impacted by the Russia-Ukraine crisis), could significantly affect results.

risks.title: Dependence on Third Party Capacity Providers
risks.score_rationale: The company exclusively uses third-party providers for transportation capacity, representing over 70,000 suppliers. Any disruption in this supply chain could affect the ability to serve customers.

risks.title: Fraud and Theft Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks of fraud and theft related to cargo transportation. These risks could lead to revenue losses and additional costs.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally (Canada, Mexico, other countries). Geopolitical conflicts, notably the Russia-Ukraine crisis affecting its second-largest agent, could impact operations.

risks.title: Regulatory and Legislative Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations on diesel emissions, air quality, and requirements to use zero-emission vehicles. Regulatory changes could affect operating costs and economic viability.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to customer credit default risk. Credit losses could impact cash flow and operating results.

ai_positioning.summary: The company LSTR does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced AI technologies in its 10-K report. The focus is on digital technologies and technological tools to support its network of agents and third-party providers.
